questions.question: What should the reporting function do?
options: Explain the findings and selected route
Call an external tool without policy
questions.explanation: Reporting explains the decision. It should not alter the underlying route or state.

questions.question: Why build the deterministic investigator before adding a model?
options: It gives us a clear, testable baseline for every later capability
It makes the API key free
It removes the need for state
questions.explanation: The deterministic version makes behaviour visible and testable. Later model-assisted behaviour must fit around that baseline.
